en: The postcard's front side shows a black-and-white photograph of a small Swedish town, featuring a large building in the foreground, a church with a steeple in the middle ground, and scenic views of the countryside with trees, a river, and distant hills. The text 'Parti af Stöde' is printed on the image. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, a green Swedish stamp (featuring King Gustav V), and is addressed to 'Fröken Betty Matsson, Vaksbala Solhem, Uppsala'.
